title: Upper Power: Press
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Lateral Lunge × 6/side · Eccentric Push-Up with Extension × 5 · Bird Dog × 6/side
jumps: DB Bench Press 3 @ RPE 7, fast → Plyometric Push-Up 4 → Med Ball Chest Pass 5 → Medicine Ball Slams 5
Power wk 1: no tempo, lighter bar, every rep max speed · 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds
Side to side over a line
strength: Bodyweight, chest to bar if you can · band to scale
note: Power block starts: no tempo, lighter heavy step. Move the bar fast, then jump.
